explanation: The reference date 2026-09-26 is never used: the age is computed against the order date (o.date), and the birthday window strftime('%m-%d', o.date) < strftime('%m-%d', date(birth_date,'+26 years')) is inconsistent with the first condition, so no line matches and the value is 0.

Off-by-one in completed age: the second branch (year difference = 24 and birthday not yet reached) selects customers aged 23, while the valid case 'year difference = 26 and birthday not yet reached' (aged 25) is missing, so the value is too low.

Period filter is correct, but the age filter ignores the birth year and compares month-day only, with two contradictory conditions (mm-dd <= '09-25' AND mm-dd > '09-25'): always false, so the value is 0.

Products and period are correct, but the birthday boundary is inverted: birth year hard-coded as 2001 with mm-dd < '09-25' and 2000 with mm-dd >= '09-25'. It excludes the customer born 2001-09-25 (exactly 25 on 2026-09-25) and includes the one born 2000-09-25 (26 that day); checked on the base.

Product and period are correct, but the age test compares a year string to a full date (strftime('%Y', date(birth_date,'+25 years')) <= '2026-09-25'); as text '2026' <= '2026-09-25' is true, so every customer born in 2001 or earlier (2002 or earlier in the other branch) is kept instead of exactly 25: value too high.
